'''Destor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ukian/Legends|Ukian]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] who served as an assistant to the [[Unidentified liege|Liege]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A downcast individual, Destor was present to welcome a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] team led by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tyzen Xebec]] to inspect Ukio's defenses. The assistant was able to prevent the [[Overliege|Liege]] from offending the newcomers before the Republican guests began their inspection tour.

==Biography==
Destor was a [[Ukian/Legends|Ukian]] who lived on [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He served as an assistant to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] ruler, the [[Unidentified liege|Liege]]. The world was subject to an inspection of its [[Ukian shield generator|considerable defense systems]], as agents of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], suspected that the planet was being targeted by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Destor accompanied the [[Overliege|Liege]] to a meeting with the inspection team, and made sure the meeting location was secure at his master's bidding. The Ukian noted that there were no disturbances to speak of.<ref name="aoi" />

[[File:LAATsOverUkio-AoI.png|thumb|250px|left|A Republic team descends upon Ukio, where Destor and the Liege will eventually greet them.]]
The Republic team was led by Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tyzen Xebec]]. The Liege was taken aback by this, and nearly made a derisive comment before Destor interjected, suggesting that his master was impressed by the young [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]. Xebec then decided to meet with the Ukian workers, while his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Ganch]], would inspect the defense facilities. The Republic team would later [[Battle of Ukio|repel]] an [[Project Instinction|incursion]] by the Confederacy, but the resultant chaos led to the ousting of Destor's Liege. Eventually, agents of the Confederacy merely bought a controlling interest in the planet, placing it directly under their control.<ref name="aoi" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I am, well&hellip;''"<br />"''Impressed, Liege?''"<br />"''Yes, that word will do.|The Liege and Destor|<ref name="aoi" />}}
Destor was a sullen individual, reporting that the location of the Liege's meeting with the Jedi arrival was as "[[Death/Legends|dead]] as a [[Burial/Legends|tomb]]" and thus earning mockery from his master. The Ukian would also interject, offering appropriate words when his Liege was lost for them.<ref name="aoi" />

==Equipment==
Destor made use of a [[Datapad/Legends|datapand]] during their duties, and wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] clothing, including a vest.<ref name="aoi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Destor first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="aoi" /> and published in [[2009]].<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref> He was introduced in the sixth installment of the webcomic, and was drawn by [[Tom Hodges]].<ref name="aoi" />
